steps.text: The sun sets. The crew shivers in the cold night of the Salt Flat.
They had to practically turn the battered ship upside down to find an old pot and some even older dried fin.
The pot begins to emit a sliver of warmth, with the help of Weedy's bionic seadragon.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It's so cold... we've used up the wood we scraped up. Leaf will have to do as a makeshift brazier for now.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It was only designed for warming hands, though. This is the best I can manage in terms of cooking.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Getting something warm to eat is more than enough!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We don't have much in the way of food or water. Enough to last us two or three days at most.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We have sacks for gathering rainwater, but... the weather on the Salt Flat is unreliable at the best of times.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Couldn't we make use of the steam outside?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: It's unsafe for drinking. It carries microorganisms from deep underground.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I could distill it.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Focus on fixing the compass first.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Anyway, our priority now should be finding a way to last through the night.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Night on the Flat is no joke. We're low on food, and we've got injuries. Get too cold in your sleep, and you might never wake up.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: R-Really? It could be over, just like that?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: What if we run into a saltfin...?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: It'll be fine! I can use my expertise to send it a message, telling it that we're here and to prepare to die!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: ...How can you be so absolutely awful at reading the mood?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You learn to live with it... He's the only one who could run his mouth in a situation like this...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Look out!
La Conquista runs over a bone and gives a violent jolt, sending the pot flying with the food inside.
Elysium leaps out to catch it, but screams as it burns his hands.
Isidro steps forward and thrusts his sword through the handles of the pot, saving their dinner.
The heat from the bionic seadragon has dissipated.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: The heating function just broke... Give me a second. I'll fix it.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Brr... ugh... it's so cold...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Achoo!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I can synthesize something that emits heat. It shouldn't take too long.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Save the materials for the compass. I'll worry about the heat.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Achoo! Achoo!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I'm sorry, c-can I have a little more blanket? I'm really freezing...

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Stop worrying about whose is whose! Everybody, huddle up! Isidro, stop sulking over there and get in here!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Count your lucky stars you get to snuggle up to a once-in-a-lifetime hottie like me...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hey! Who threw a blanket over my head?
Juana blocks the opening with her body. Teach helps Pascuala wrap herself tight, with only her face peeking out, grimacing from the cold.
Elysium and Weedy are struggling to move their stiff fingers to pick up the food and put it in their mouths.
Isidro wants to go back to the transmutation table, but realizes that his frozen fingers are of no use when he picks up the probe.
La Conquista sails aimlessly with the wind.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Brr... where are we going?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: No idea. Deeper in, I suppose.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: So we don't know where we're going...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: We don't know when those finshit preachers will catch up to us...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: And we don't even know if I'll freeze to death in my sleep, or if the ship will hit something again...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What's gotten into her?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I thought she'd be the first to find the warmest spot to lie down, maybe steal our blankets when we're asleep.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: She's just a child.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: She's asleep, with a bit of fever. See if she has any useful herbs in her pocket.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: If I'm gonna die here... I wanna sleep in my old home... one last time...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: That big house... my bed, my blankets, my bathtub...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: My prettiest clothes, all lined up...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: All the food I can eat... all the money I can spend... no more getting kicked out...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Getting kicked hurts so bad... rolling from one end of the street to the other... I just wanna go home...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Wanna live a better life...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Don't wanna die... not here...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm sorry, Weedy. I didn't think it'd be so dangerous. I really shouldn't have brought you here.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Don't worry about it. I came to help.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: If we make it back to Rhodes Island in one piece, I'll give you a month's worth of pay, I promise!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Heh, no need for that... Go to sleep, we can talk in the morning...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thorns? What're you up to?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Fixing the compass, otherwise we'll never make it out of Skeletal Reef.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: The way the ship's shaking, I need to build an Arts field of sufficient complexity to stabilize the Corazonix. Otherwise, the entire compass could fall apart the moment I try to disassemble it.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: And even if such a field is possible, I'll need a steady hand to carry out the rematerialization process properly...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: The slightest trembling when etching the liquid Originium circuit into the Corazonix could ruin the whole material...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Plus, when tomorrow comes, I'm not sure if we could...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: It's no surprise he's tired. He's been learning the helm on the fly all day. He's never done anything like this before, has he?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...No, his training was in communications.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Get closer. The temperature's still dropping. It'll be warmer if we huddle up.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Perlita, do you want to...

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Señora...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: ...Papá said you used to sail the seas... Is it really blue?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Papá... will you take me to see it? When I grow up... I want to sail the sea...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Perlita, you...
Juana had told that story while holding young Teach in her arms, so very long ago.
She places a hand on Teach's forehead. There are wrinkles on it now.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Teach has a fever too, Isidro. Do you have any herbs left?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Let me see...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Here.
In the quiet cabin, the sound of rustling punctuates the low breathing of the sleeping. Isidro places both pot and rack on top of the repaired bionic seadragon and prepares to boil the herbs.
Juana gazes at the barebones interior of the cabin with soft eyes, seemingly recalling sweet memories.
She puts the herbs into the pot. They make a soft, splashing sound, rocking along with the ship.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Have you ever seen the sea, Isidro?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Waters bluer than the sky, waves foaming white, lightning striking from the clouds that seem like they would cut you in two...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Will you sail out to sea with us, Isidro?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You'd make a good captain.
Juana's eyes glow in the darkness. Cold starlight shines in through the ship's frame.
He opens his mouth to answer, but closes it again without a sound.
There is a light in the horizon, in the direction of where they came from. It is their pursuers.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Canvas, finhide, wood, relics of the Golden Age...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: But virtually no food or water. You were desperate.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: It always takes such dire straits for man to understand the value of order.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: ...Maybe.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Subservience to order has brought you food, water, and shelter. Do not forget this.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: ...My mates understand parley. They'll keep to the agreement.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Very good. You will make a fine privateer.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: One who answers to me.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Log the confiscated supplies. Record the names of the bandits, then bring them to the abandoned houses on the edge of the town.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Take care not to draw the townsfolks' attention.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: And I want those ships of theirs that traverse the Salt Flat to be brought back without a scratch. They are the town's only hope.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Understood, Señor Silver.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Anything else?

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: We...

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: We tried looking for the Alguacil, but found only a fragment of his clothing. I left it on your desk.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: I will take it from here. Now go. I wish to be alone for a while.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Anastasio, Anastasio...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: I thought you would save us all.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: But you never cared for anything other than yourself, did you?
The piece of cloth leaves soot on the desk that he had kept so pristine. Silver picks it up with two fingers and stares at it.
Finally, he throws it into the fireplace, and starts wiping the desk clean.
The same way he climbs the clock tower every day, gazing upon this town that has survived calamity both natural and man-made.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: You don't care about this country, this town, or these people. That's why you'll never understand.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: From the most prosperous harbor to the poorest village, every settlement in Iberia that survived the sea went on to collapse in the chaos that followed.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Aarón was no exception. I am the one who devoted half my life to this place, who saved it from the tragedy of cannibalism and the terrors of tyranny...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: And I am the one who will bring it salt ships that walk the land, who will liberate it from this barren soil.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: All you can see, Anastasio, is your stubborn, archaic faith.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: You will never belong to Aarón. You will never interfere with Aarón again.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: ...My Aarón.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Legs driven by wind power through a complex transmission system...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: So they were never meant to be landships at all. A wind-powered walker... genius.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: A shame. That Ægir woman had such talent...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: A handful of new ships, plus the ones confiscated from the pirates, will be enough to carry the entire population of Aarón.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: It's been decades... Finally, we will be free of this Salt Flat that feeds no one.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Where did that sudden wind come from?

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: ...What is going on?

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Is this house really that drafty? I couldn't even light a fire.
A few small tiny sparks fly out from the end of the match, only to be extinguished in an instant.
A tiny flame sways in the wind, the flickering light illuminating the darkness.
His eyes begin to adjust and take in his surroundings.
He sees a face. Skin pale as salt, punctuated by red-brown blood stains. Wet hair hanging feebly off the head like entrails.
The face of a dead man.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: You... you...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: No one could have survived that explosion...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: How did you do it? What are you?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: On our first meeting, I was wounded walking the Flat on foot to reach Aarón.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: You asked if I needed help.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: At the time, you thirsted for nothing more than to aid me.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Now? When you halted the clerics coming to my aid, when you gleefully imagined my death... what was it you sought?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: You were also corrupted by desire just like the others, no?
Not a word comes out of Silver. He grabs at the air as he collapses, but only manages to pull out the drawer.
Flower petals pour out, covering him in them.
Dried flowers, rotted flowers, flowers that had turned to dust. Flowers from a few years ago, from a decade ago, from decades ago.
The flowers that the townsfolk had offered to their calificador in gratitude over the years, all pour down upon him.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: ...Flowers?

a.text: He hears the sound of a knife being honed, before it comes to a sudden stop.
There is a commotion outside. His mother screams, screeching and beseeching, claiming that she was honing it to cut vegetables.
He had not seen vegetables in the house for a long time.

steps.name: Inquisition Cleric
steps.text: You are safe, child.

steps.name: Inquisition Cleric
steps.text: Madness has come over your mother, but we have her under control.

steps.name: Inquisition Cleric
steps.text: By the lantern... what is that he's eating?

steps.name: Young Anastasio
steps.text: No! No!!!

a.text: He screams hysterically like his mother, waving his hands wildly, trying to cover his own face.
Fearing that the clerics would smell the flesh, see the scraps by his mouth.
He had been determined to end his sinful existence by death. Why, then, as he comes face to face with this kindly man of the cloth, would he strive to hide his crime?

steps.name: Young Anastasio
steps.text: I have sinned... please, let me die...

steps.name: Inquisition Cleric
steps.text: No, child. I will not judge you for trying to survive.

steps.name: Inquisition Cleric
steps.text: You must live and atone for your sins.

steps.name: Inquisition Cleric
steps.text: Sinners are myriad. We have walked the land helping those who could not atone themselves, and cleansing them of their sins.

steps.name: Inquisition Cleric
steps.text: This you can do also. Only by this will you atone for your own sins.

steps.name: Inquisition Cleric
steps.text: Until one day, the purest flower will bloom at your touch.
